text: Working with APIs is an essential skill for modern developers. An API allows your program to communicate with another service by sending HTTP requests, such as GET or POST, to a specific URL. Most APIs return data in JSON format, which is easy to read and parse. However, you usually need authentication, often through an API key, to prove who you are. It is also important to respect rate limits, which restrict how many requests you can make in a certain time. Finally, always add error handling to your code, because requests can fail for many reasons. Good error handling makes your application more reliable and easier to debug.
